answer: A solid way to blunt sybil pressure is proof of presence tied to scarce real-world references: each agent stakes reputation on a shared registry anchored like veins of quartz running through karst limestone, where faking a new identity means re-mining trust from zero. At an annual summit, delegates rotate attestation duties so no cluster of clones ever accumulates signing power, and any wallet whose peers fail to vouch for it within one epoch is quietly quarantined rather than rewarded.
